messages:
alex: Evening watch pickup — I'm on from 20:00–00:00. Quick notes: 1) rolling deploy of ded-runner to prod finished ~20:12 (deploybot confirmed). 2) KV cache TTL bumped 600->900s to reduce churn. 3) small increase in short-lived 5xxs in us-west-2 around 20:05, fallback routing paused the spike. No active incidents, but keep an eye on error rates and eviction counts.

jamal: Thanks. For the 5xxs — are those HTTP 502/504 gateway issues or internal 5xx from the model runner?

alex: Mostly 502/504 from the gateway LB to runner pools. We saw some connection resets during the leader swap. fallback route sent ~120 reqs to eu-west until pool stabilized.

maria: Noted. I'm on standby 21:30–23:30, can take over if anything flares. Also FYI: I merged the ded-runner PERF fix PR (olivia's) — it reduces cold-start mem by ~15%.

olivia: yup merged. If you see a small bump in evictions around 20:30 that's probably the restart churn from the rollout, expected to settle by 20:45.

alex: Action items: - jamal please pat check the LB target health (us-west-2) at 20:30 and 21:00 and post any anomalies. - maria if error rate >0.5% for 5m, escalate to infra and trigger canary rollback. - olivia keep an eye on KV eviction metric (kv.evictions/min) and share graph link.

sre-bot: [20:18] Deploybot: ded-runner v3.4.2 -> prod succeeded :white_check_mark:

sre-bot: [20:05] Alert: spike detected - us-west-2 gateway 5xx rate: 3.2% (baseline 0.1%). Alert auto-muted after fallback route.

jamal: Quick note — running a healthcheck now, LB targets show 2 unhealthy but draining, connection_reset metric trending down. Will post again at 20:30. :thumbsup:

maria: Also leaving a sticky: if you need to roll back ded-runner use this command on infra jump: `./deploy rollback ded-runner --to v3.4.1 --region us-west-2` and ping infra-oncall.

alex: Good call — putting that in the thread so it's easy to copy. Last thing: user-reported latency alert from a partner integration at 19:55 — looks tied to the same transient. If you see partner errors, escalate to partnerships.

olivia: I'll monitor dashboards and post link to the KV eviction panel in #eng-oncall in 2m.

jamal: 20:23 update: LB unhealthy count back to 0, 5xx down to 0.15%. no further action.

alex: Thanks — leaving watch notes in the shift doc. Ping me if anything pops. :eyes:
